title: A subagent is a second Claude with its own context window #shorts
description:
Not five workers reporting back — a second Claude with its own context window. It does the greps, the log reads, the forty files over there, and returns one summary. The noise never touches your main conversation.

Not more agents. Less context.

Docs: https://code.claude.com/docs/en/sub-agents
